1.1.0.text: Turn rough notes into a formal daily Report.
Review past Digests and edit the Report template.
Prepare a Zimbra message for multiple recipients; you send it yourself.
Zimbra recipient addresses no longer lose characters.

1.2.0.text: Use Local AI to turn Items into Report sentences.
Choose a Cloud fallback when Local AI cannot finish.
See sentences appear as they are written.
Use past sent Reports as wording examples for Local AI.
Past Reports stay on this computer.

1.2.1.text: The company Zimbra address is filled in by default.
Download Daily Digest from its new website.

1.2.2.text: Daily Digest now has its own icon in Windows.
The setup guide shows where to set recipients and edit the Report template.

1.3.0.text: Find out when a new version is available, right in the app.
Turn on a daily alarm in Settings to remind you to write today's Digest.
See updates, alarms, errors and reminders in one Notifications page.
A new look with dot-matrix titles and the app logo.
The app recovers from crashes and shows an error instead of an empty window.
Sent and scheduled status stay correct, and the Digest date is kept with your draft.

1.4.0.text: Save a generated Report as a draft and pick it up again next time you open Daily Digest.
Dropdown menus in Settings are no longer cut off, so every date format can be chosen.

1.4.1.text: Closing the window now asks whether to keep Daily Digest running or quit, so you can always close the app.

1.4.2.text: Long recipient lists and subjects no longer run off the edge of the Send Daily Digest window.
